newsitem.title: UK: INSTANT VIEW -Gilts and short stg on election news.
newsitem.headline: INSTANT VIEW -Gilts and short stg on election news.

text.p: Following is a selection of market reactions to news on Monday that British Prime Minister John Major called an election for May 1.

"I suspect the market has effectively discounted the news already this morning, so it won't come as a surprise. I would expect the (gilt/Bund) spread to widen ahead of the election...I think we'll see 190 basis points, maybe 200 if you're very pessimistic. The difficulty for gilts is the two auctions during the campaign. They could be a signal for spread widening."
"The government have got six or seven weeks to do something about (the opposition Labour party's) poll lead, but they're very unlikely to make it back from here.

A gilt/Bund spread of 178 basis points with sterling at this level is a good opportunity to put that spread on..for an international investor. You're probably looking at a narrower spread post-election and for sterling to gain so you're looking to win on both the spread and the currency.
We expect a bit of short term volatility but weakness of gilts is a buying opportunity.
Short sterling should pretty well have understood there will be a rate increase shortly after the election because the new Chancellor will want to establish credibility soon afterwards."

"There's a genuine worry that the exchange rate is an accident waiting to happen... The temptation to take profits is quite high. The other concern is the way the chancellor has overridden the Bank of England (by not raising interest rates).
"We're going into the election with quite a vulnerable background."
